records.prompt:
EDIT/IDENTITY PRESERVATION: The sole input is the exact burly mafia character to animate. Make a NEW GREAT knockdown animation sprite sheet, FOUR frames in a square 2x2 layout, reading order. Do not redesign this man. He is a VERY BROAD, HEAVY, STOCKY thick-necked enforcer, NOT a slim or medium man. Trace the input's physical proportions: massive wide shoulders and deep torso/belly, thick upper arms, VERY THICK thighs and substantial calves, large broad jaw, same big face and fedora. Preserve that massive body in the kneeling and lying poses: torso cannot flatten to a slim man's waist or shoulders. Clothes remain NEAR-BLACK jacket and trousers with restrained dark highlights exactly like input, NOT gray, NOT light charcoal. Olive-brown vest, white shirt, black tie, gold watchchain, same dark pistol.
Treat him as a fixed articulated model with unchanged bone lengths and limb widths. Same face size, hat size, shoulder width, torso length, thigh/shin length and thickness, hand and shoe size in every panel. Fixed orthographic camera and identical pixels-per-unit, no pose individually zoomed to fit. All four frames must obviously be this heavy man.
Frame1 chest hit, still upright, hand clutching chest, pistol lowered, slight knee bend. Frame2 knees buckle, massive torso pitches forward SCREEN LEFT, legs fold, feet trail right. Frame3 both knees on ground, heavy torso supported by one arm on floor to SCREEN LEFT, head lowered left. Frame4 arm collapses, lies heavily on belly/left side, HEAD SCREEN LEFT and bent feet SCREEN RIGHT, thick belly and thick thighs remain visible. No facing reversals. Natural progressive movement.
Square sheet, 2x2 SAME square panel dimensions with ample transparent gutters. Same ground baseline at 90% height of each panel; body in frame1 occupies 75% panel height, all remaining poses keep EXACT same anatomical size, not same bounding-box dimensions. Natural bent legs fit lying body; do not compress it. Maintain black cloth luminance in every panel; no palette shift on impact.
Transparent alpha, only character silhouettes, no environment, no glow/halo, no vignette, no floor, no contact shadow, no blood, no captions or panel borders. Match input's polished dark painted game sprite rendering.

EDIT, exact character model preservation. Sole reference is the SMALL SHORT SLENDER mafia gunman, NOT a regular muscular man. Redraw this exact man into FOUR GREAT-hit collapse poses on a square 2x2 sprite sheet. Preserve his noticeably NARROW shoulders and chest, narrow pelvis, VERY THIN straight trouser legs (thin thighs AND thin calves), slender forearms, long narrow angular face, small stature. NO MUSCLE GROWTH, no thick baggy trousers, no broader torso on crouching, no enlarging skull on falling. His legs must remain pencil-slim like the input, NOT the wide bulky legs commonly drawn for mafia thugs. Same total skeleton lengths, same small face, fedora, hand/shoe size, narrow lapels, fine pinstripe dark near-black suit, burgundy tie, dark vest and gold watchchain.
A single articulated actor at constant orthographic scale. His head size, upper arm/forearm lengths, torso length, thigh/shin length and thickness remain fixed in all four panels. Lower height comes ONLY from bending joints, never shrinking or inflating anatomy. Never auto-fit different poses to equal bounding-box sizes. Preserve reference's slim leg-to-body ratios and black suit colors, no bright gray material.

Full pistol retained, two correct arms, two correct legs, same three-quarter facing throughout.
Precise square sheet divided into 2x2 square cells with safe gutters; complete figures including feet, no overlap across panels. Shared local ground baseline at 90% each panel height, standing pose 75% cell height; identical anatomical drawing scale in every cell, lying may occupy more width naturally. Exact same painted style and warm edge highlights as reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT background outside silhouettes, no halo/glow/vignette, no ground plane/shadows, no text, no grid, no blood.
